text: Never have I ever gone on a road trip alone
Never have I ever eaten an entire pizza by myself
Never have I ever stayed up all night watching a show
Never have I ever cried at a commercial
Never have I ever talked to a pet like it understood me perfectly
Never have I ever forgotten someone's name immediately after being introduced
Never have I ever pretended to be on the phone to avoid someone
Never have I ever eaten food that fell on the floor
Never have I ever laughed so hard I cried
Never have I ever sent a text to the wrong person
Never have I ever gotten lost in a city I know well
Never have I ever made a birthday wish that actually came true
Never have I ever gone skinny dipping in an appropriate setting
Never have I ever kept a journal for more than a month
Never have I ever tried to learn a new language
Never have I ever baked something from scratch and been proud of it
Never have I ever stayed in bed all day for no reason
Never have I ever named a plant or inanimate object
Never have I ever made a wish at a fountain and thrown a coin
Never have I ever been in a flash mob or organized surprise event
Never have I ever learned a magic trick
Never have I ever sat through an entire movie I hated just to be polite
Never have I ever tried to pet an animal that then ran away
Never have I ever started a book and never finished it (more than 3 times)
Never have I ever taken a cold shower on purpose
